BETA Close X Serco Group plc has announced the purchase of 212,195 ordinary shares on December 3, 2025, at a volume-weighted average price of 261.5769 pence, with the shares intended for treasury. This brings the total shares purchased under the current buy-back programme to 21,112,140. Following these transactions, Serco holds 21,112,140 shares in treasury, leaving 1,002,743,103 ordinary shares in issue, which will serve as the denominator for shareholder notification calculations. Disclaimer* Serco Group PLC 04 December 2025 Serco Group plc Legal Entity Identifier: 549300PT2CIHYN5GWJ21 Transactions in own shares Serco Group plc (the Company ) announces the purchase of 212,195 ordinary shares of 2 pence each (the Ordinary Shares ) through J.P. Morgan Securities plc on 3 December 2025. The Company intends to hold all of the purchased Ordinary Shares in treasury. Since the announcement of the share buy-back programme on 7 August 2025 (the Programme ), the Company has purchased a total of 21,112,140 Ordinary Shares. Following the transactions referred to in this announcement, the Company holds 21,112,140 Ordinary Shares in treasury and has 1,002,743,103 Ordinary Shares in issue (excluding treasury shares). The total number of Ordinary Shares with voting rights will be 1,002,743,103 which may be used by shareholders as the denominator for the calculations by which they will determine if they are required to notify their interest in, or a change to their interest in, the Company under the Financial Conduct Authority's Disclosure Guidance and Transparency Rules.
